title: 外倾岩包低横移
description: 剪纸展现低岩包支撑的浅外倾横移，人物与墙型层次分明。

art_direction.medium: colored pencil sports sketch with layered visible pencil marks
art_direction.scene: An original layered-paper illustration shows a fictional fully clothed adult traversing across a shallow overhanging wall using a broad low volume for foot support. Both shoes remain engaged on positive ledges, while large coral handholds form a compact horizontal route. The climber moves one hand to a nearby edge without jumping or swinging away from the panel. Show a wide side-oblique scene with layered teal wall geometry, visible paper fibers, the whole figure, and thick uninterrupted crash mats. Keep the padded landing empty and expansive. Adult proportions and natural hand orientations remain credible. Use no lettering, logos, high exposure, strained contortion, or portrait-only framing.
